name: My Funeral is Sunday
source:
Mio Tachibana is alive, perfectly healthy, and holding her own funeral on Sunday.

She's invited three people: Haruto, a classmate who's become part of her everyday life; Yuta, a boy who isn't sure why she chose him; and Reina, a former friend who would rather leave the past alone.

Nobody knows quite what Mio is trying to accomplish. But she has rules for the occasion, and everyone is expected to participate.

Told from Haruto's perspective, *My Funeral Is Sunday* is a character-driven visual novel about friendship, unresolved feelings, uncomfortable truths, and the things people struggle to say to one another.

Official Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5354900/My_Funeral_Is_Sunday/
